messages:
Rhea Malhotra: hey all, quick onboarding Q — trying to map who to ping for: repo write access, pager adds, and VPC subnet approvals. any short list?
Owen Blake: welcome Rhea! short answers: repo perms = repo-admins (cc @Claire Mendes for infra repos), pager adds = eng-oncall via infra ticket, VPC subnet approvals = people-ops + eng-platform.
Rhea Malhotra: thanks Owen. repo-admins — do I file a GH team request or is there a form?
Claire Mendes: file the "Repo Access" form on the infra board and include your SSO email + reason + repo list. repo-admins will grant write and add the team.
Rhea Malhotra: noted. for pager adds  what's the exact infra template name?
Owen Blake: use "PagerDuty: add user" and include SSO email, service tag (e.g., svc:feature-ingest), role, and linked approval ticket.
People-Ops: people-ops note: VPC changes require both the access request and a security review. submit the "Vault/VPC Entitlement" template and tag eng-platform for the subnet work.
Rhea Malhotra: good to know. last small one  who signs off emergency DB read during incidents?
Eng-Platform: automation: emergency access approved by oncall lead + people-ops. File "Emergency Access" and mark P0; include timebox and justification.
Rhea Malhotra: awesome. filing the repo and pager tickets now — will drop links when done. thanks for the quick map! :wave:
